title: ECG-SDI: Single-lead Electrocardiogram Enables Continuous Sleep Depth Index Profiling and Scalable Digital Biomarkers for Sleep Health
abstract: arXiv:2610.23727v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Conventional sleep staging provides a coarse-grained representation that obscures within-stage depth variation. We developed ECG-SDI, a single-lead electrocardiography (ECG) framework for continuous sleep-depth profiling and digital biomarker extraction. Using 12,392 overnight polysomnographic recordings, we trained and validated a two-stage deep learning model supervised by conventional sleep-stage labels. Correlations with ordered stages excluding rapid eye movement (REM) sleep were 0.828 in the pooled internal test set and 0.848 in the external Cleveland Family Study; corresponding REM classification AUROCs were 0.954 and 0.977. Overnight trajectories captured within-stage variation. Biomarker-based phenotyping identified a disturbed subtype associated with poorer subjective sleep quality and higher all-cause mortality in the Sleep Heart Health Study (adjusted hazard ratio, 1.20; 95% CI, 1.05-1.38). translated_title: ECG-SDI：单导联心电图实现连续睡眠深度指数分析及可扩展的睡眠健康数字生物标志物
translated_abstract: 传统的睡眠分期提供了一种粗粒度的表征，掩盖了分期内的深度变化。我们开发了ECG-SDI，这是一个基于单导联心电图（ECG）的框架，用于连续睡眠深度分析和数字生物标志物提取。我们使用12,392份整夜多导睡眠图记录，训练并验证了一个由传统睡眠分期标签监督的两阶段深度学习模型。在合并的内部测试集中，与排除快速眼动（REM）睡眠的有序分期的相关性为0.828，在外部克利夫兰家庭研究中为0.848；相应的REM分类AUROC分别为0.954和0.977。整夜轨迹能够捕捉分期内的深度变化。基于生物标志物的表型分析在睡眠心脏健康研究中识别出一种紊乱亚型，该亚型与较差的主观睡眠质量和较高的全因死亡率相关（校正风险比，1.20；95% CI，1.05-1.38）。在507名具有配对……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究开发了基于单导联心电图的ECG-SDI框架，可利用常规心电信号连续刻画睡眠深度变化并提取数字生物标志物，其识别的睡眠紊乱亚型与较差的主观睡眠质量及更高的全因死亡风险显著相关。
en_tdlr: ECG-SDI is a single-lead ECG framework enabling continuous sleep-depth profiling and scalable digital biomarkers, identifying a disturbed sleep subtype associated with poorer subjective sleep quality and higher all-cause mortality.
